interpretation: The intentional PRX stop/restart overlapped the PTX hardware-ACK retry boundary. One final pre-restart payload was delivered again in the new PRX session. EsbRadio::begin() resets its session-local last_sequence, so the otherwise ordered duplicate was not marked by the backend. This interpretation is inferred from the exact +1 DUT count, peer 4000/4000 result, post-restart backend 2001 count, and zero corruption/drop/timeslot failures.
corrective_action: Keep a logical-session last sequence in the W10 DUT across the intentional driver restart and exclude only a consecutive identical sequence. Do not relax packet, corruption, loss, service-gap, restart, negative, or cleanup boundaries.
